title: OpenID AuthZEN WG drafts (COAZ, AARP) define a competing decision envelope for MCP tool authorization with a third 'prerequisite pending' ou

entity.name: OpenID AuthZEN WG — COAZ (MCP Tool Authorization) + AARP
urls: https://openid.net/openid-foundation-advances-authorization-for-the-agent-era-with-new-authzen-working-group-drafts/ (HTTP 200 on 2026-09-06): 'The AuthZEN Working Group approved the AuthZEN Access Request and Approval Profile (AARP) and the AuthZEN Profile for Model Context Protocol Tool Authorization (COAZ) as official Working Group Drafts. AARP addresses what happens when policy cannot yet authorize an action because a prerequisite (approval, consent, delegated authority, attestation, risk assessment) must first be satisfied.'
